## Watch out · Shared lab computers

- sign out of every service and the browser
- never save passwords
- private window on other people's devices
- lock the screen

## Try it 1 · Accounts and sign-in

a) a password
b) a code on your phone
c) a fingerprint
d) one sign-in, many services
e) the risk of SSO
f) end of every lab session

::: {.answer}
a) something you know
b) something you have
c) something you are
d) single sign-on
e) a stolen password opens every service
f) sign out of every service
:::

## Example · Why 128 GB shows 119 GB

::: {.reveal}
1. sold: 128 × 10^9^ bytes
2. counted in 2^30^ = 1 073 741 824 bytes
3. 128 × 10^9^ / 2^30^ ≈ **119 GB**
4. nothing is missing — only the unit
:::

## Try it 2 · Paths, types and sizes

a) Windows separator?
b) starts at the root?
c) `..` means?
d) `budget.xlsx` opens in?
e) `photo.jpg.exe` is?
f) "128 GB" in powers of 1024?
g) 24 × 3.5 MB?

::: {.answer}
a) backslash (\\)
b) absolute path
c) the parent folder
d) a spreadsheet
e) a program
f) about 119 GB
g) 84 MB
:::

## 2.3 Naming files · no spaces · YYYY-MM-DD · v01

| Poor | Better |
|---|---|
| `New Document (3).docx` | `2026-10-21_DS_week01_cv_v01.docx` |
| `final final.pptx` | `2026-11-12_pitch-deck_v03.pptx` |
| `IMG_4821.jpg` | `2026-10-21_lab-desk-photo.jpg` |

## Try it 3 · Good names

a) date format that sorts in time order?
b) instead of "final2"?
c) instead of spaces?
d) best name: DS week 1 CV, 21 Oct 2026?

::: {.answer}
a) YYYY-MM-DD
b) version numbers (v01, v02)
c) a hyphen or an underscore
d) 2026-10-21_DS_week01_cv_v01.docx
:::

## 2.4 Sync is not backup

![](images/sync-backup.png)

## Example · A deleted project folder

::: {.reveal}
1. deleted on the lab PC → **deleted everywhere** (sync)
2. cloud recycle bin → restore in time
3. weekly USB copy at home → safe anyway (**3-2-1**)
:::

## Try it 4 · Sync or backup?

a) deleted on one, gone on all?
b) independent copy?
c) 3 · 2 · 1?
d) earlier versions of a file?
e) maximum storage allowed?

::: {.answer}
a) synchronization
b) backup
c) the 3-2-1 rule
d) version history
e) quota
:::
